summative_rubric.title: Data Detectives — Summative Rubric

rows.expectation_text: sort objects or data using one attribute

levels.descriptor: Re-sorts the same set by different attributes.

rows.expectation_text: collect and record data to answer questions of interest, and display it in concrete graphs or picture graphs
respond to data in concrete graphs and picture graphs by interpreting it and drawing conclusions

levels.descriptor: Makes pictograph with prompts and supports.
Makes pictograph with one picture per item.
Aligns rows for visual comparison; labels groups.

rows.expectation_text: describe how likely familiar events are to happen

levels.descriptor: Uses SOMETIMES as a catchall for every event.
Sorts ALWAYS / NEVER / SOMETIMES with prompts.
Independently sorts events into ALWAYS / SOMETIMES / NEVER.
Justifies SOMETIMES with 'not every day, not no day' and gives own examples.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Apply this rubric to combined evidence from Lesson 5 capstone.
summative_rubric.layout_description: One letter page, landscape. 5-column grid with 4 rows.

summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — My Detective Mission
administration_steps: Score: sort + tally + graph + describe = L3; plus reflection = L4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Question (out of 2) + survey (out of 2) + graph (out of 3) + describe (out of 3) = 10.
